messages:
incident-bot: Paging @oncall_sam — latency anomaly detected for /v1/generate (p95 spike). automated alert: p95 crossed 900ms in us-east-1 for the last 5m. traces flagged: increased KV fetch times.
oncall_sam: ack. re-routing traffic to dedicated fallback pool, will post updates. tagging #incidents.
marco_eng: I'm jumping in — any customer-facing errors reported? metrics show increased tails but 200 OK rate still high.
jen_ops: we have 3 customer complaints within last 10m mentioning slow responses on chat features. Impact looks partial (5% of requests).
alexa_sre: attaching quick timeline from APM: 12:14:00 baseline p50 ~120ms p95 ~520ms -> 12:22:00 p50 ~180ms p95 ~1100ms. change correlated with kernel rollout to 5.19.14 on some hosts (canary group).
oncall_sam: good catch. marco, can you confirm which hosts are in canary?
marco_eng: canary set: gpu-pool-{a3,a4,a5} (about 18% of capacity). those nodes show elevated runqueue lengths and scheduler latency.
jen_ops: mitigation enacted: 12:27 re-routed 40% traffic away from canary to stable pool; 12:30 scaled stable pool +4 nodes.
marco_eng: collecting perf and trace spans now. sharing console logs. snippet:```
[12:21:47] span=kv_fetch duration=420ms service=node-12
[12:21:47] span=attn_kv_read duration=380ms
[12:21:47] kernel: sched_migrate_task: heavy_push on cpu3
```
alexa_sre: running perf sampling on affected host. command used:```
sudo perf record -a -g -- sleep 30
sudo perf script | FlameGraph/stackcollapse-perf.pl > out.folded
```
perf-bot: perf summary (top symbols):
- 28% copy_user_generic_string
- 15% finish_task_switch
- 12% __switch_to
Suggests scheduler/syscall path is hot.
marco_eng: also seeing increased softirq and local_bh_time in /proc/softirqs on canary nodes. kernel change included a scheduler default tweak (sched_latency_ns lowered).
oncall_sam: hypothesis 1: scheduler parameter change causing longer context switch or runqueue thrashing under our inference workload (many short-duration CPU-bound threads on GPU host). hypothesis 2: a kernel regression in the 5.19.14 patch affecting page-fault handling for pinned memory causing KV reads to stall.
jen_ops: can we validate hypothesis 2 quickly? any page-fault spam in dmesg?
marco_eng: grep output:```
[ 12:20:59 ] NMI watchdog: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#3 stuck for 23s
[ 12:21:10 ] show_stack+0x...
```
not full OOM, but stall events align with p95 spikes.
alexa_sre: another quick check — traced span breakdown: tokenize(14ms) -> attn_kv_lookup(420ms) -> decode(30ms). The attn_kv_lookup is the dominant sigmoid.
oncall_sam: immediate actions: 1) keep canary traffic low (done), 2) roll back kernel on one canary host and observe, 3) gather full perf data and upload to incident doc. can someone run rollback on gpu-pool-a4?
jen_ops: starting rollback on a4 now (takes ~6m). will route its traffic to stable during upgrade.
marco_eng: while rollback runs, collecting additional counters: vmstat, iostat, /proc/sched_debug snapshot, and strace of attn process to see syscall wait.
marco_eng: paste:```
# /proc/sched_debug snippet
runqueue: 12 tasks, loadavg 3.4
rr runqueue avg_latency: 240us
```
oncall_sam: if rollback reduces p95 back to baseline, that's a strong signal. set alert to notify if p95 < 600ms for 2 consecutive minutes post-rollback.
perf-bot: uploaded perf flamegraph to https://internal-storage/redwood/perf/2976543210/flamegraph.svg
marco_eng: rollback finished on a4 at 12:36, rejoined LB. observed p95 drop from ~1100ms -> ~510ms over 90s.
alexa_sre: confirms trace spans on a4 post-rollback: attn_kv_lookup down to 180ms.
oncall_sam: conclusion for in-incident: kernel rollout seems causal. mitigation: pause rollout, rollback remaining canary nodes, keep autoscale + routing.
jen_ops: will open a rollback PR and incident ticket for the kernel team. tagging @kernel-team for follow-up.
marco_eng: next steps for RCA: - collect full perf samples from before/after - capture trace span samples across multiple hosts - diff /proc/sched_debug and sysctl values - check kernel changelog for scheduler or memory path changes.
alexa_sre: adding hypothesis tracking to incident doc with links to perf and traces.
oncall_sam: good. customer comms: send templated note that we mitigated a latency regression caused by recent kernel canary, that rollback is in progress, and that we have minimal impact to functionality. jen, can you draft?
jen_ops: draft prepared, will send after headcount review.
marco_eng: any other data points needed live? please paste any strace/syscall histograms here.
perf-bot: also captured perf counters: context-switches +42%, local_page_faults +130% on affected nodes.
marco_eng: saving logs to incident doc: https://internal-docs/incidents/2976543210. will update RCA section with analysis and command list for repro.
oncall_sam: handoff note for next oncall: monitor p95, ensure kernel rollout paused, keep routing policy in place, contact kernel-team for full regression fix.
incident-bot: Incident 2976543210 status: mitigated -> partial rollback completed. next: RCA writeup assigned to marco_eng.
